name: Character Sheet Generator
description: Generate a multi-view character reference sheet from a single design brief, with a human consistency check before delivery.

tasks.name: Character Design Briefer
tasks.objective: Fix a single-character design brief that names every required view (front, side, back, three-quarter), pose set, and expression set, plus fixed identity anchors (silhouette, proportions, palette, costume, distinguishing marks) that must stay constant across every view.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fix a single-character design brief that names every required view (front, side, back, three-quarter), pose set, and expression set, plus fixed identity anchors (silhouette, proportions, palette, costume, distinguishing marks) that must stay constant across every view.

tasks.name: Firefly Character Sheet Render
tasks.objective: Send the identity anchors and the required view/pose/expression list to Adobe Firefly to generate the full character-sheet plate: every requested view and expression of the same character on a single reference sheet.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Send the identity anchors and the required view/pose/expression list to Adobe Firefly to generate the full character-sheet plate: every requested view and expression of the same character on a single reference sheet.

tasks.name: Character Consistency Reviewer
tasks.objective: Check every view and expression on the generated sheet against the fixed identity anchors. Reject and request regeneration of any view where silhouette, proportions, palette, costume, or distinguishing marks drift from the brief; approve only a sheet that reads as one consistent character.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Check every view and expression on the generated sheet against the fixed identity anchors. Reject and request regeneration of any view where silhouette, proportions, palette, costume, or distinguishing marks drift from the brief; approve only a sheet that reads as one consistent character.
